title: Representation

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Choose the level of attribution that suits the space so IBM’s relationship remains understandable even without a logo.
strategic_value: Flexible text and logo options can help partners acknowledge IBM clearly across different formats.
demonstration: Four quadrants compare text-only attribution, logo alone, partner-logo grouping and logo with a relationship statement.
practical_value: Choose a representation based on whether the surrounding content already explains IBM’s role and whether space permits the logo.

content_islands.name: Representation guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the four named options and their conditions in the left column.

content_islands.name: Text and logo alone
content_islands.spec: Show text-only attribution and the isolated IBM logo in the upper quadrants.

content_islands.name: Partner grouping and statement
content_islands.spec: Use the lower quadrants for a partner-logo group and an IBM mark with relationship copy.

reference_purposes.Application: The page offers four representation modes and explains when each works, including text-only for small spaces.
reference_purposes.Constraint: IBM’s role must always be clear; the logo must not occupy a signature position implying IBM authored the partner communication, and clear space remains required.
